description:
Don’t Count AVAX Out Yet — Short-Term Pain, Bottom in Sight

This Changes EVERYTHING for AVAX, Here is Why I'm Extremely Bullish - AVAX AVALANCHE  - AVAX Technical Analysis-AVAX Price Prediction 2025-Technical analysis tutorial: 

In this video we break down the new Bitwise Avalanche ETF and why it’s a major moment for AVAX.
This is the first U.S. crypto ETF that includes staking rewards, and it could create real demand, real supply reduction, and a totally new path for Proof-of-Stake assets to enter traditional finance.

At the end, we also look at the AVAX chart to see whether the market is already reacting.

If you’re following AVAX or the PoS sector, this is one update you don’t want to miss.
